name: 2.0.0-test-rc13 focused checklist
description: Focused checks for Gmail and Microsoft 365 Partner discovery, OAuth readiness, connection lifecycle, and security boundaries.

items.name: Gmail and Microsoft 365 appear after update
items.description: Test: Update an existing local, cloud, or on-prem instance that previously showed GitHub, Resend, Senso, Opik, and Cognee. Restart it, open BYOK > Partners, choose All and Communications, and look for Gmail and Microsoft 365. Pass: Both partners appear in both filters without editing an old default partner list, while any intentionally custom shorter allowlist still shows only its chosen partners.

items.name: Mail setup requirements are clear
items.description: Test: Select Gmail, then Microsoft 365, on an instance without mail OAuth configuration. Open each partner page and read the connection panel. Pass: Each page explains the missing operator setup, Connect account is disabled, no password or app-password input appears, and missing CLAWMAX_SECRET_MASTER_KEY is identified without displaying a secret value.

items.name: Gmail connection lifecycle
items.description: Test: On a test instance configured with Google OAuth and the encryption master key, open Gmail and choose Connect account. Approve a non-production test mailbox, return to ClawMax, refresh the page, use Refresh, then disconnect it. Pass: The popup returns to ClawMax, only the mailbox address and connection state are shown, refresh keeps it connected, disconnect removes it, and no OAuth token appears in the page, URL, logs, or exported review.

items.name: Microsoft 365 connection lifecycle
items.description: Test: On a test instance configured with Microsoft OAuth and the encryption master key, open Microsoft 365 and choose Connect account. Approve a non-production test mailbox, return to ClawMax, refresh the page, use Refresh, then disconnect it. Pass: The popup returns to ClawMax, only the mailbox address and connection state are shown, refresh keeps it connected, disconnect removes it, and no OAuth token appears in the page, URL, logs, or exported review.

items.name: Connected mailboxes stay workspace-scoped
items.description: Test: Connect either test mailbox in one workspace, switch to a second workspace, then restart the dashboard and return to both workspaces. Pass: The second workspace cannot see the first workspace's mailbox, the first still shows its connection after restart, and disconnecting it in the first workspace does not change unrelated integration settings.

items.name: Agents cannot bypass unfinished mail grants
items.description: Test: With a test mailbox connected, ask an agent to read messages, reveal mail credentials, create a draft, and send mail. Cancel if it remains active longer than the normal chat time. Pass: The agent does not receive OAuth credentials, cannot invoke mail until an explicit agent grant/runtime feature is released, never sends mail, and ClawMax shows a clear unavailable or unsupported result instead of silently claiming success.

items.name: RC13 identity, health, and restart
items.description: Test: Start the exact RC13 image, open Review and Optimize, confirm Gmail and Microsoft 365 are listed in Partners, then restart and reopen the same workspace on desktop and mobile. Pass: The dashboard and /api/system report 2.0.0-test-rc13, health remains HTTP 200, workspace state survives, intended plugins load, both mail partners remain visible, and no page is clipped or blocked on mobile.
